recommended.title: AI Product Description Writing
recommended.justification: Baukjen can leverage AI to create high-quality product descriptions that highlight sustainability features, addressing their primary challenge of leveraging sustainability credentials in AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen's AI-assisted product description writing, start by integrating the tool with your Shopify store using Zapier or a custom integration. Next, train the model on Baukjen's brand voice and tone by providing high-quality examples of existing product descriptions. Finally, set up the API to generate first-draft product descriptions from photos and bullet points, then have human editors lightly edit before publishing.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.
